text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Adding an accent color might 
give off a brighter impression. I'd 
recommend brown or red♪

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I usually stick to pale tones, so 
this feels pretty fresh. I'll give it a 
try. Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fu-chan's Fashion Advice: On the Road. The 
event held on the academy's stage drew 
huge excitement, especially among female 
fans.

text_block_list.name: Unconfident Woman
text_block_list.text:
H-Hello, Flight-chan... What do you think 
of my outfit...? If it doesn't look good, 
please tell me straight.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Not at all, you don't look bad in the 
slightest! It's cool, mature, and so very 
wonderful♪

text_block_list.name: Unconfident Woman
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so? But this is completely 
self-taught...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If you did it all yourself, that makes it 
even more amazing! It really accentuates 
your sharp, gorgeous features and your 
sleek figure, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as North Flight said, the woman's 
outfit was honestly very tasteful. It was 
a mystery why she lacked so much 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Unconfident Woman
text_block_list.text:
Um, this might be a strange question, 
but... Flight-chan, why are you always so 
sparkly and bright?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, if you think so, then it must be 
thanks to this outfit.

text_block_list.name: Unconfident Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Flight-chan designed this... racewear, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I asked Trainer, and they left 
everything to me.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A voluminous scarf, mature wine red and 
black tones, and vertical lines that 
create a gorgeous silhouette—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Racewear is something you can only wear 
in special races. That's why I wanted it 
to bring out the most wonderful 'me' 
possible."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I believe that special sparkle gives me 
the power to run... I really do.

text_block_list.name: Unconfident Woman
text_block_list.text:
Is that so. That's nice... If clothes like 
that existed, I'm sure that person would 
also...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ? That person... you mean?

text_block_list.name: Unconfident Woman
text_block_list.text:
Um... T-The person I like. We have plans 
to have dinner tonight...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You were planning on wearing that outfit, 
but you're feeling a bit unsure of it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'll put together a special 
coordinate for you, Miss. Could you wait 
just a moment?

text_block_list.name: Unconfident Woman
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Yes, I'm okay.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once the event settled down, North Flight 
went to the training track along with the 
woman.

text_block_list.name: Unconfident Woman
text_block_list.text: Um, what are you doing here...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Just watch me for now. I'm sure you'll 
understand everything just from that, 
Onee-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No sooner had she said it than North 
Flight dashed gracefully onto the turf.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...! Phew............!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she accelerates, the ribbon at her 
waist flutters and spreads wide. 
Resembling pure white wings, she looks 
just like a bird dancing through the sky, 
or an airplane.

text_block_list.name: Unconfident Woman
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! Flight-chan, you look so 
dazzling...!

text_block_list.name: Unconfident Woman
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see. Yeah, yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a radiant expression like a 
completely transformed person, the woman 
headed home. Standing beside North Flight, 
I watched her walk off with her back held 
a little straighter.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I hope your date goes well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without even changing her outfit, North 
Flight gave the woman a magnificent 
styling. I could only marvel at her talent 
for making a person's very heart shine.
choice_data_list: So even feelings need coordinating, huh.

Guess even feelings need coordination, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When people choose an important 
outfit, they pour their wishes and 
feelings into it.

text_block_list.name: Unconfident Woman
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Flight-chan, I remembered! 
I... I really, really...! wanted to wear 
this outfit so badly!

text_block_list.name: Unconfident Woman
text_block_list.text:
So, I took the plunge and dyed my hair, 
went on a bit of a diet, and... became a 
pretty version of myself worthy of this 
outfit!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
She had those feelings within her all 
along. She had just lost sight of them for 
a little while.
choice_data_list:
The feelings put into your racing outfit 
were wonderful.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu... How did you take it, Trainer?

choice_data_list: You want to dance like a bird, don't you?
You want to dance like a bird, right?

You want to soar like an airplane, right?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! I got the idea for this ribbon's 
design from watching birds soar up while 
splashing sparkling water♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I want to run freely, as if flying... 
Someday that will come true, right? If I'm 
with you, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I'll definitely make it come true!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I need to find the styling that is 
uniquely North Flight's. To bring the 
feelings poured into her Racewear to 
life!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! I chose this ribbon's color after 
seeing an airplane soaring through the 
sky♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I want to try running with all my might, 
faster than anyone else... That'll come 
true someday, right? As long as I'm with 
you, Trainer!"
